title: Rapid ice shelf thinning in the Antarctic Peninsula: implications for sea level rise
authors: Kumar, R., Sharma, P., Patel, A.
abstract: This study presents comprehensive analysis of ice shelf dynamics in the Antarctic Peninsula region using satellite altimetry and ground-based radar measurements. Results indicate accelerated thinning rates of approximately 2 meters per year over the past decade.
keywords: ice shelf,Antarctic Peninsula,climate change,sea level rise

title: Accelerated permafrost degradation in the High Arctic: 2024 observations
authors: Sharma, P., Singh, R., Gupta, M.
abstract: Long-term permafrost monitoring in Svalbard reveals accelerated degradation patterns with implications for global carbon cycle feedbacks. Active layer thickness increased by 15cm compared to 2023 measurements.

title: Southern Ocean temperature and salinity variability during the 41st IAE
authors: Patel, A., Kumar, R., Singh, S.
abstract: CTD measurements collected during the 41st Indian Antarctic Expedition along the Antarctic Peninsula transect reveal significant interannual variability in water mass properties and circulation patterns.

title: Atmospheric aerosol characteristics in the Arctic summer: results from IAR-12
authors: Verma, A., Gupta, R., Krishnan, M.
abstract: Continuous aerosol monitoring at Himadri station during summer 2023 shows elevated black carbon concentrations linked to long-range transport from industrial regions. PM2.5 levels peaked during specific meteorological conditions.

title: Biological responses to changing sea ice conditions in the Antarctic Peninsula
authors: Krishnan, M., Patil, S., Kumar, R
abstract: Analysis of phytoplankton community structure and primary productivity during the 40th IAE indicates shifts in species composition correlated with changing sea ice extent and duration.

title: Permafrost carbon feedback mechanisms in the Svalbard archipelago
authors: Gupta, R., Verma, A., Sharma, P
abstract: Investigation of permafrost thaw dynamics during the 11th IAR reveals complex interactions between soil carbon stocks, microbial activity, and hydrological changes in response to warming temperatures.
